Title: 10% Niacinamide & Rice Water Brightening Face Serum For Clear & Bright Skin
Body (HTML):
Plum's 10% Niacinamide & Rice Water Serum is a fragrance-free, vegan serum formulated for oily, acne-prone, and combination skin. It contains pharmaceutical-grade 10% niacinamide — the concentration shown in clinical studies to visibly reduce sebum production and fade post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation. The formula adds Matmarine, a marine extract that further regulates oil without drying the skin, acetyl glucosamine for gentle brightening, and dual zinc to control shine throughout the day. The serum is stability-tested, pH-balanced for daily use, and safe for sensitive skin and beginners. Results: reduced oiliness in 2–3 weeks, faded blemishes and clearer skin tone in 6–8 weeks. Apply 3–4 drops morning and evening after cleansing, before moisturiser. 100% vegan and PETA-certified cruelty-free.

Title: Green Tea Pore Cleansing Face Wash For Oily & Acne-Prone Skin
Body (HTML):
features of green tea pore cleansing face wash:

*gentle cleansing
*non-drying gel-based formula

green tea pore cleansing face wash benefits:

*fights pimples & pimple-causing bacteria​
*cleanses pores deeply​
*removes excess oil & impurities​

Why green tea and glycolic acid?

Acne-prone and oily skin needs a cleanser that does two things simultaneously: remove the excess oil and bacteria that cause breakouts, and do so without stripping the skin barrier in the process. Most face washes do one or the other. This one does both, because the two key actives work on entirely different mechanisms.

Green tea extract — derived from Camellia Sinensis leaves — is one of the most studied botanical ingredients in dermatology. Its active compound, EGCG (epigallocatechin gallate), is a powerful antioxidant that directly inhibits the growth of Cutibacterium acnes, the bacteria responsible for inflammatory acne. It also suppresses sebum production at the sebaceous gland level, which means oil control is happening at the source rather than just on the skin surface. On top of this, EGCG reduces inflammation, which is why skin looks calmer and less red after washing.

Glycolic acid, an alpha hydroxy acid derived from sugarcane, works on the surface. At low concentrations in a rinse-off formula, it gently breaks the bonds between dead skin cells, encouraging them to shed evenly. This prevents the buildup of dead skin that clogs pores and leads to blackheads and whiteheads. The result over time is smoother, more even-textured skin — not from scrubbing, but from chemistry.

What the clinical study found

This face wash was tested in a 32-user clinical study conducted at an independent, expert-graded lab in October 2024. The findings were clear: 99.9% removal of pore-clogging impurities per wash, and 88% of users observed a measurable reduction in acne within just 7 days of use. Oil control was clinically confirmed to last up to 2 hours post-wash — a meaningful result for anyone who typically experiences shine and congestion within an hour of cleansing.

The full ingredient story

Beyond green tea and glycolic acid, this formula includes natural cellulose beads that provide gentle mechanical cleansing — dislodging surface debris and helping unclog pores without the micro-tears caused by harsh physical scrubs. The gel base is built on a mild surfactant system that produces a soft lather sufficient to lift dirt and excess oil without disrupting the skin's natural moisture barrier. Glycerin acts as a humectant throughout, drawing water to the skin so it feels hydrated rather than dry after rinsing. The formula is free from parabens and contains no ingredients that would compromise the skin microbiome with regular use.

Who this face wash is for

This face wash was specifically developed for oily, combination, and acne-prone skin — including teenage skin dealing with hormonal breakouts and adult skin prone to congestion and shine. It is the right choice if your primary concerns are active pimples, blackheads, clogged pores, and excess oil that returns quickly after cleansing. It also suits anyone who has tried harsh acne face washes and found them too drying or irritating — the non-stripping gel formula makes it gentle enough for twice-daily use without compromising the skin barrier. If your primary concern is brightening or dry skin, the Plum 2% Niacinamide & Rice Water Face Wash may be a better fit.

How to fit this into your skincare routine

Use this face wash twice daily — morning and evening — as the first step in your routine. In the morning, follow with an alcohol-free toner to balance skin pH, then a lightweight moisturiser and SPF. In the evening, this face wash is compatible with most active serums including niacinamide, azelaic acid, and low-concentration retinol. Because this formula already contains glycolic acid, avoid using a separate high-strength AHA toner or peel on the same evening to prevent over-exfoliation. For best results with acne reduction, use consistently for a minimum of 4 weeks — clinical improvement in acne is typically visible from week one, but full skin texture benefits from glycolic acid develop over 6 to 8 weeks of regular use.

Why green tea and glycolic acid?

Acne-prone and oily skin needs a cleanser that does two things simultaneously: remove the excess oil and bacteria that cause breakouts, and do so without stripping the skin barrier in the process. Green tea extract — derived from Camellia Sinensis leaves — is one of the most studied botanical ingredients in dermatology. Its active compound, EGCG (epigallocatechin gallate), is a powerful antioxidant that directly inhibits the growth of Cutibacterium acnes, the bacteria responsible for inflammatory acne. It also suppresses sebum production at the sebaceous gland level, which means oil control is happening at the source rather than just on the skin surface. On top of this, EGCG reduces inflammation, which is why skin looks calmer and less red after washing.

Glycolic acid, an alpha hydroxy acid derived from sugarcane, works on the surface. At low concentrations in a rinse-off formula, it gently breaks the bonds between dead skin cells, encouraging them to shed evenly. This prevents the buildup of dead skin that clogs pores and leads to blackheads and whiteheads. The result over time is smoother, more even-textured skin — not from scrubbing, but from chemistry.

What the clinical study found

This face wash was tested in a 32-user clinical study conducted at an independent, expert-graded lab in October 2024. The findings were clear: 99.9% removal of pore-clogging impurities per wash, and 88% of users observed a measurable reduction in acne within just 7 days of use. Oil control was clinically confirmed to last up to 2 hours post-wash — a meaningful result for anyone who typically experiences shine and congestion within an hour of cleansing.

The full ingredient story

Beyond green tea and glycolic acid, this formula includes natural cellulose beads that provide gentle mechanical cleansing — dislodging surface debris and helping unclog pores without the micro-tears caused by harsh physical scrubs. The gel base is built on a mild surfactant system that produces a soft lather sufficient to lift dirt and excess oil without disrupting the skin's natural moisture barrier. Glycerin acts as a humectant throughout, drawing water to the skin so it feels hydrated rather than dry after rinsing. The formula is free from parabens and contains no ingredients that would compromise the skin microbiome with regular use.

Who this face wash is for

This face wash was specifically developed for oily, combination, and acne-prone skin — including teenage skin dealing with hormonal breakouts and adult skin prone to congestion and shine. It is the right choice if your primary concerns are active pimples, blackheads, clogged pores, and excess oil that returns quickly after cleansing. It also suits anyone who has tried harsh acne face washes and found them too drying or irritating — the non-stripping gel formula makes it gentle enough for twice-daily use without compromising the skin barrier. If your primary concern is brightening or dry skin, the Plum 2% Niacinamide & Rice Water Face Wash may be a better fit.

How to fit this into your skincare routine

Use this face wash twice daily — morning and evening — as the first step in your routine. In the morning, follow with an alcohol-free toner to balance skin pH, then a lightweight moisturiser and SPF. In the evening, this face wash is compatible with most active serums including niacinamide, azelaic acid, and low-concentration retinol. Because this formula already contains glycolic acid, avoid using a separate high-strength AHA toner or peel on the same evening to prevent over-exfoliation. For best results with acne reduction, use consistently for a minimum of 4 weeks — clinical improvement in acne is typically visible from week one, but full skin texture benefits from glycolic acid develop over 6 to 8 weeks of regular use.

Title: 2% Niacinamide & Rice Water Face Wash For Clear & Bright Skin
Body (HTML):
Benefits:
*removes 99% pore-clogging impurities
*90% users felt clean, fresh skin
*brightens skin tone
*softens & smoothens skin texture
*gently cleanses off dirt & excess oil

Features:
*gentle on skin
*non-drying formula
*sulphate-free

Why niacinamide and rice water?

Most face washes clean skin and stop there. This one goes further. Niacinamide — also known as vitamin B3 — is one of the most extensively researched skincare actives in dermatology. At 2%, it works at the cellular level to reduce the transfer of melanin to the skin's surface, visibly fading dark spots and post-acne marks with consistent use. It also regulates sebum production, which means oily skin stays balanced rather than stripped and compensating with even more oil.

Rice water has been used in Asian skincare for centuries, and modern research backs what tradition already knew. It contains inositol, a carbohydrate that helps repair damaged hair and skin, along with amino acids and vitamins B and E that smooth texture and strengthen the skin barrier. Together, niacinamide and rice water don't just cleanse — they actively improve the quality of your skin with every wash.

What the clinical study found

This face wash was tested in a 32-user clinical study conducted at an independent, expert-graded lab in December 2024. The results: 99% removal of pore-clogging impurities and 90% of users reported clean, fresh-feeling skin after every use. The study also confirmed the formula is non-irritant, making it suitable for daily use across all skin types including sensitive skin.

The full ingredient story

Beyond niacinamide and rice water, two more actives do important work in this formula. Hyaluronic acid — a molecule capable of holding up to 1,000 times its weight in water — helps the skin retain moisture during and after cleansing, so skin never feels tight or dry post-wash. Provitamin B5 (panthenol) acts as a humectant and skin-soother, reducing redness and supporting the skin barrier. The cleansing base itself is sulphate-free, relying on gentler surfactants like Cocamidopropyl Betaine and Coco Glucoside that lift dirt and oil without disrupting the skin's natural pH.

Who this face wash is for

This face wash was formulated for anyone dealing with dullness, uneven skin tone, post-acne marks, or dry and tight-feeling skin after cleansing. It works particularly well for normal, dry, and combination skin types. If your primary concern is brightening and texture improvement rather than active acne or severe oil control, this is the right cleanser. It is also a strong choice for anyone who has experienced irritation or dryness from other face washes, since the sulphate-free, non-drying formula is gentle enough for twice-daily use even on sensitive skin.

How to fit this into your skincare routine

Use this face wash as the first step in both your morning and evening skincare routines. In the morning, follow it with a toner, a niacinamide or vitamin C serum, moisturiser, and SPF. In the evening, if you are using active ingredients like retinol or an AHA serum, this face wash is gentle enough to precede them without compromising your skin barrier. For best results, use consistently twice daily — brightening and dark spot reduction from niacinamide typically become noticeable within 4 to 6 weeks of regular use.

Beyond niacinamide and rice water, two more actives do important work in this formula. Hyaluronic acid — a molecule capable of holding up to 1,000 times its weight in water — helps the skin retain moisture during and after cleansing, so skin never feels tight or dry post-wash. Provitamin B5 (panthenol) acts as a humectant and skin-soother, reducing redness and supporting the skin barrier. The cleansing base itself is sulphate-free, relying on gentler surfactants like Cocamidopropyl Betaine and Coco Glucoside that lift dirt and oil without disrupting the skin's natural pH.

Who this face wash is for

This face wash was formulated for anyone dealing with dullness, uneven skin tone, post-acne marks, or dry and tight-feeling skin after cleansing. It works particularly well for normal, dry, and combination skin types. If your primary concern is brightening and texture improvement rather than active acne or severe oil control, this is the right cleanser. It is also a strong choice for anyone who has experienced irritation or dryness from other face washes, since the sulphate-free, non-drying formula is gentle enough for twice-daily use even on sensitive skin.

How to fit this into your skincare routine

Use this face wash as the first step in both your morning and evening skincare routines. In the morning, follow it with a toner, a niacinamide or vitamin C serum, moisturiser, and SPF. In the evening, if you are using active ingredients like retinol or an AHA serum, this face wash is gentle enough to precede them without compromising your skin barrier. For best results, use consistently twice daily — brightening and dark spot reduction from niacinamide typically become noticeable within 4 to 6 weeks of regular use.
